Title: Why Moss Killer and Lime Don't Fix a Shady Lawn
Description: Moss returns because shade lets it beat thin grass, and killers or lime alone don't change that. Count your sun hours, then fix the spot or switch to a groundcover.

Title: How much water it takes to flush salt out of a garden bed
Description: Not really. Rock salt hurts plants as spray and as salty meltwater in the soil. Six steps keep it out of beds, plus how many gallons a 6-inch spring flush takes.
